clips.speaker: Ron Temple
clips.title: Lazard首席策略师：中国AI或更便宜，但股东回报存疑
title_lines: 但股东能否赚钱仍是挑战

subtitles.zh: 随着时间推移，企业甚至个人用户会寻找可靠且便宜的AI。在很多情况下，中国AI似乎更有能力赢得这一市场份额。
subtitles.en: Over time, enterprise users and individuals will look for reliable AI that is inexpensive. In many cases, Chinese AI looks better positioned to win that market share.

subtitles.zh: 这是否意味着在中国AI和科技领域更容易寻找超额收益，而韩国、台湾和美国更多只是跟随大盘？
subtitles.en: Does that mean Chinese AI and technology offer a better search for alpha while Korea, Taiwan and the US are more of a beta play?

subtitles.zh: 我还不能说中国供应商一定是股东赚钱的最佳途径，但毫无疑问，AI将带来广泛而深刻的变化。
subtitles.en: I am not ready to say Chinese providers are the best way for shareholders to make money, but there is no doubt AI will be revolutionary and ubiquitous.

clips.speaker: Elisabeth Behrmann
clips.speaker_context: Bloomberg European autos editor reporting on Volkswagen
clips.source_title: Volkswagen Plans to Cut Model Lineup by as Much as 50%
clips.title: 大众汽车车型减半成本谈判未达预期

subtitles.zh: 大众汽车宣布计划将车型阵容削减多达50%。
subtitles.en: Volkswagen announced plans to cut its model lineup by as much as 50%.

subtitles.zh: 这个节约计划没有就更大规模的人员调整和德国工厂安排达成一致。
subtitles.en: The savings plan stopped short of an agreement on deeper workforce reductions and German factory plans.

subtitles.zh: 把车型阵容减半可以大幅降低复杂性，而复杂性一直拖慢大众。
subtitles.en: Halving the model lineup would sharply reduce the complexity that has been slowing Volkswagen down.

subtitles.zh: 外界原本讨论的是更大动作，但公告更像一份理想很多、细节很少的谈判起点。
subtitles.en: The market discussed bigger moves, but the announcement looked more like a starting point for talks, long on ideals and short on specifics.

subtitles.zh: 大众需要降低成本、提高灵活性，关键是赶上竞争对手。
subtitles.en: Volkswagen needs to lower costs, become more nimble and, crucially, catch up with competitors.

subtitles.zh: 来自中国汽车企业的竞争真实存在，而且正在加剧。
subtitles.en: Competition from Chinese automakers is real and rising.
